additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0373180 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s) :
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
Maybe
Onsite Troubleshooting
Yes
End Customer Communication
Yes
Spare Part Ordering
Maybe
Performance monitoring by RC
Please arrange a site intervention as the charger is offline on both the SCB and OCPP backend. Kindly check if power is being supplied to the charger from the downstream source. Also, please bring an extra SIM card, a router, and a couple of Ethernet cables to get the charger back online on SCB. Additionally, ensure you have a Siemens-configured laptop with MobaXterm and the Companion Tool ready for use.
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue, or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline on ISP.
Later assign the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2) Team
, using "
Assign
" function and then move the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
using "
Add to Queue
".
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Shrey Sharma
